purpose: Data-only acceptance corpus for canonical Vault timeline retrieval. Historical evidence only; this file does not define ranking architecture or current truth.

base.note: Baseline query observations used current-main collector/query code with read-only live memory/worker archives. Source counts can advance; intended links and negative controls are the durable acceptance contract.

acceptance_semantics.expected_links: Events that should be discoverable and rank materially above generic token-sharing noise for the stated historical question.
acceptance_semantics.negative_controls: Events/patterns that may match a token but must not dominate the answer unless stronger case anchors make them relevant.
acceptance_semantics.baseline_rank: Observed current behavior, not the desired rank. null means the expected event was missed entirely.
acceptance_semantics.pass_shape: For each case, retrieve at least one primary expected link in the first page and avoid filling that page with generic project/merge/token matches. Preserve explicit causal falsifiers/corrections when the question asks why something happened.

historical_prompt.kind: issue-derived task text preserved in finalized worker history
